verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a public HTTP API across its products: Directory Sync APIs and an Events API, RBAC configurable "using the API", and the AuthKit migration API. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, and official SDKs wrap "every HTTP API method" with retries and pagination. Its official MCP server also lets agents call the WorkOS API to manage organizations, connections and users. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of driving the API programmatically; the pack has no direct API-reference excerpts beyond the probe.
